response.sql: WITH rates AS (SELECT m.MediaTypeId, m.Name, CAST(SUM(t.Bytes) AS REAL) / SUM(t.Milliseconds) AS rate, COUNT(*) AS track_count FROM MediaType m JOIN Track t ON t.MediaTypeId = m.MediaTypeId GROUP BY m.MediaTypeId, m.Name), avg_rate AS (SELECT AVG(rate) AS avg_rate FROM rates) SELECT r.Name, r.rate, r.track_count, r.rate - a.avg_rate AS above_average FROM rates r CROSS JOIN avg_rate a WHERE r.rate > a.avg_rate
